svg.desc: The vision transformer from bottom to top: a 96 by 96 image cut into a 6 by 6 grid of 16 by 16 patches; a strided convolution that embeds each patch as a token; a learned cls token prepended to the 36 patch tokens and learned position embeddings added; L pre-norm encoder blocks with multi-head attention and a GELU MLP on the residual stream; and a final norm and linear head that read the cls output only.
